prices.planName: Evotel 30/30 Mbps Uncapped Combo — new service
prices.setupNotes: New Evotel service purchase; existing services, migrations, service changes and pre-orders are excluded. Monthly fees are VAT-inclusive, billed by calendar month and paid in advance. Standard installation/activation is subsidised up to R3,000; extra work costs more. A free-to-use router has R249 delivery. Cancellation or transfer within six months costs R499 plus one calendar month's notice; no downgrades during those six months. Return the loan router within 21 days or pay R899; ownership transfers after 36 months. Confirm any collection or non-standard setup fees and address coverage. Acceptable-use rules apply.
prices.promoTerms: R499 for the activation month, pro-rated, and the following calendar month; then R549 per calendar month. New Evotel service purchase; existing services, migrations, service changes and pre-orders are excluded. Confirm promotion availability before ordering.

prices.planName: Openserve 30/30 Mbps — new Mweb customer / new installation
prices.setupNotes: This record covers new Mweb customers with a new installation; existing customers cannot downgrade to it. The provider also mentions ISP switches, whose eligibility needs confirmation. R249 processing is payable upfront. Setup is included subject to recovery/cancellation costs within 12 months; the exact recovery amount is unconfirmed. Monthly fees are paid in advance, normally by debit order; the first bill depends on activation date. One calendar month's cancellation notice applies. Return the optional loan router within 20 days, at your courier cost and in original condition/packaging, or pay its retail value. Uncapped and unthrottled; shaping applies.
